description: A painted interior of a computer room. In the foreground a man in a white shirt and dark trousers leans over a console with a panel of blinking lights and switches, reading a paper. Beside him a man in a dark suit stands at the console. Behind them rows of boxy blue-grey cabinets, several with open reel tape drives, stretch back into a dim room with fluorescent ceiling lights and cables on the floor. Other people in office clothes are at desks in the background.
